meta.title: Eddie Football Coaching — Lake County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Clermont, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Eddie
about.bio: As a former D1 defensive lineman and All-State high school football player, my love for sports and competitive games has been a part of me for most of my life! My focus is on building better players on and off the field through focusing on mechanics, building endurance, and developing a winning mentality while having fun and enjoying what we’re doing.

hero.headline: Lake County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.

testimonials.quote: Best investment we've made in our son's athletic career. Coach Eddie is the real deal.
testimonials.name: Sandra K.

testimonials.quote: Coach Eddie doesn't just coach the sport — he coaches the whole athlete. That made all the difference.
testimonials.name: DeShawn F.
